dedupeText: rustic illustrated album cover hand drawn folk art plaid shirt vertical typography textured background naive illustration subject is centered between top and bottom horizontal text blocks vertical text columns flank the central figure symmetrically the red of the plaid jacket is echoed in the outlines of the vertical text a dark blue rectangular sticker element overlaps the right side of the central figure combine a centered folk art portrait with a four sided framing of heavy hand lettered block typography using a limited palette of navy red and gray

recipe.visualDefinition: A centered, hand-painted portrait of a bearded man in a red plaid jacket and black cap, set against a flat, textured gray background. The composition is framed by large, blocky, hand-lettered text on all four sides, creating a square border effect with a naive, folk-art aesthetic.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject is centered between top and bottom horizontal text blocks.
Vertical text columns flank the central figure symmetrically.
The red of the plaid jacket is echoed in the outlines of the vertical text.
A dark blue rectangular sticker element overlaps the right side of the central figure.
coreInvariants: Hand-painted, non-photorealistic texture on the central figure.
Uneven, organic outlines on all lettering.
Muted, desaturated gray background with subtle paper-like texture.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central figure occupies the middle 60% of the frame vertically and horizontally.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The dark blue block of the name at the top and bottom anchors the verticality.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the top name, moves down through the portrait to the bottom name, then scans the vertical side text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant gray space between the central figure and the surrounding text blocks to prevent crowding.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Medium gray background providing a neutral canvas.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep navy blue used for primary name text and the informational sticker.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant red used for the plaid pattern and vertical text outlines.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High contrast between the dark navy text and light gray background; moderate saturation in the red accents.

letterConstructionRules: Irregular, hand-drawn strokes with varying thickness.
Heavy weight with minimal internal counters.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters like 'U' and 'O' have slightly squashed, organic shapes.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Heavy navy block letters for primary identity paired with outlined white vertical text for secondary messaging.
graphicDevices: Faux-sticker overlay with rounded corners and diagonal texture.
White halo effect around primary text to separate from background.

candidateDirections.reason: Similar heavy weight and playful blocky feel.
Matches the folk-art, DIY aesthetic of the original.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a gouache-style illustration of a man with a beard, wearing a black baseball cap and a red and black plaid flannel jacket. The background should be a flat, textured medium-gray paper. Leave ample space at the top, bottom, and sides for text.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply large navy blue hand-lettered uppercase text at the top and bottom. Add vertical columns of white uppercase text with red outlines on the left and right sides. Place a dark blue rectangular sticker with white sans-serif text on the right side of the portrait.

verificationChecks: Is the portrait hand-painted in style?
Is the text arranged in a border-like frame?
Does the color palette consist of gray, navy, and red?
Is the primary text heavy and blocky?

adjustableVariables: Width of the vertical text columns
Intensity of the hand-drawn wobble in the lettering
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
Exact wording of the song titles on the sticker
Any specific artist signatures or logos

mustAchieve: Clear hierarchy between primary and secondary text

postGenerationChecks: Ensure text is legible despite the hand-drawn style.
Check that the red in the jacket matches the red in the text outlines.
Verify the 'sticker' looks like a separate physical element.
Confirm the vertical text is read top-to-bottom.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a centered folk-art portrait with a four-sided framing of heavy, hand-lettered block typography using a limited palette of navy, red, and gray.
